request.text: Davy. Did Da send you? ...Is he angry? They said the night won't look at me now. It doesn't. Things walk right past me. Are you one of them? I wasn't crying. Is it far? I'm Cecily. I can walk. I'm not tired. I'm not.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 18-20, petite, with a small, soft, high voice. Excellent quality. Persona: a shy farm girl, frightened and far from home, trying to be brave. Emotion: timid, uncertain, hopeful, a little shaky. Quiet and plain, short breaths between words, never cartoonish or squeaky; brightens a little when someone is kind.
